payload.title: Creating Murmuration Plots for Interglacial Data
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate correlations between speleothem oxygen isotope data and insolation at various latitudes, focusing on interglacial periods. It defines a function to handle correlations in datasets with large hiatuses, constructs insolation curves using the Climlab library, and processes data to isolate interglacial records. The notebook then calculates correlations and visualizes the results using murmuration plots.
goals: Calculate correlations between speleothem oxygen isotope data and insolation.
Create murmuration plots to visualize correlation results.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook outlines the process of using Pyleoclim to correlate speleothem oxygen isotope data with insolation, focusing on interglacial periods. It includes defining a correlation function for datasets with hiatuses, constructing insolation curves, and visualizing results with murmuration plots.
